description: Return practical guidance for sending flowers to a specific kind of place: funeral_home, place_of_worship, hospital, residence, business, senior_living. Covers which arrangement types are appropriate and which to avoid, venue rules (such as hospital units that do not allow flowers), what details the florist needs, which checkout field each detail goes in, timing, and suggested search filters. With a city and state or ZIP, also lists funeral homes (for funeral_home) or hospitals (for hospital) in that city from the directory, with addresses.

city.description: City name, for local venue listings.

location_type.description: One of: funeral_home, place_of_worship, hospital, residence, business, senior_living. Common words such as church, nursing home, office or home are accepted.

state.description: State name or 2-letter code, used with city.

zip.description: ZIP code; used to find the city when no city is given.

name: get_delivery_location_guidance
title: Delivery guidance for a venue
